title: PM–Eng 1:1 prep — API/Console/Dedicated/Private
content:
Purpose: quick sync before the exec review next week; surface any risks for the Console + Dedicated rollout and align on prioritization 

Attendees: Samira (PM), Ethan (Eng lead) — bring up anything for Lena/console infra if needed

Agenda:
- Quick health check (metrics) — 5m
- Console rollout status + canary results — 10m
- Dedicated capacity ETA and gating issues — 10m
- Private deployment (on-prem) pilot updates + compliance checklist — 10m
- Blockers / risks / escalations — 10m
- Action items & owners — 5m

Context / why this matters:
- Exec review on 2026-03-08 will include a demo and timeline for Dedicated and Console improvements. Need to be confident on SLOs and known risks.
- Recent customer feedback: two mid-market customers requested private VPC on-prem template; security wants audit logs compliance ready for pilot.

Key metrics to mention (recent week):
- Hosted API 99p latency (token-gen): 130ms (target <120ms) — small regression after last kernel update.
- Console route success rate: 99.6% (target 99.9%) — errors concentrated on upload/preview flow.
- Dedicated capacity provisioning lead time: median 48h (target 24h) — provisioning script failure on certain instance types.
- Private pilot readiness: 60% checklist complete (KMS integration done; audit logs pending).

Updates / Notes to surface:
1) Console rollout canary (region us-west-2) — saw increased 500s on upload preview between 02/20–02/22. Root cause appears to be a race in the preview job queue when cache misses spike. Ethan: have a patch that batches preview jobs; need to validate under load.
2) Kernel upgrade (v1.14) lowered cost for long-sequence requests but introduced minor latency regression for short prompts — hypothesis: adaptive kernel selection not falling back correctly for seq<64. Eng team investigating.
3) Dedicated provisioning script failing on N-series GPUs in eu-west-1 — infra bug related to AMI tagging. SRE assigned a ticket (INF-2345).
4) Private on-prem pilot: Compliance asked for detailed audit log schema (fields/timestamps/user-id). Security will require immutable logs + retention policy. Contact: Anika Patel (security).

Decisions we should try to make in this 1:1:
- Do we delay wider console rollout until preview batching patch validated in canary? (risk vs velocity)
- Rolling back kernel v1.14 for short prompts vs quick patch to adaptive selector.
- Prioritization: fix Dedicated provisioning in EU vs finish Private audit logs for pilot — which is higher priority for next sprint?

Blockers / Risks (to escalate if needed):
- If console preview errors persist, customer demos next week could be impacted (risk: lost momentum with pilot customers).
- EU Dedicated provisioning failure could delay a committed customer delivery (potential revenue/CS impact).
- Audit log schema delay blocks on-prem pilot; legal needs signoff before pilot starts.

Proposed mitigations / suggestions:
- Hold canary steady; push patch to canary and run synthetic preview workload for 48h. If stable, continue rollout. If not, rollback preview-service to previous version for canary only.
- For kernel regression: short-term: enable safe-path that forces legacy kernel for seq<64 until adaptive-fix lands (low risk). Long-term: regression test added to CI with short-seq microbench.
- For Dedicated provisioning: workaround manual AMI tag fix for affected zones and create runbook; schedule automated fix in next infra sprint.
- For audit logs: draft schema today, loop in Anika + legal for signoff by 2026-02-28 to keep pilot on schedule.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ethan: deploy preview-batching patch to canary + run 48h synthetic test; report results in #console-canary by EOD 2026-03-02.
- Samira: prepare a short slide for exec review showing canary metrics + mitigation plan (due 2026-03-04).
- Lena: coordinate with SRE on manual AMI tagging workaround and add runbook entry (due 2026-03-03).
- Anika (security): provide audit log schema draft and retention guidance (due 2026-02-28).
- Eng infra (assigned via INF-2345): prioritize automated AMI tagging fix in next infra sprint and estimate ETA (update by 2026-03-05).
- Samira/Ethan: decide on kernel rollback vs selector-patch by 2026-03-01; if rollback chosen, create rollback PR and test plan.

Parking lot / topics for next sync:
- Cost implications of Dedicated autoscaling policies (need sample numbers)
- Improve canary observability for console flows (tracing + heatmaps)
- Private deployment packaging (installer UX) feedback from SEs

Notes to self (things to ask Ethan):
- How confident are you in the preview-batching patch? Any edge cases?
- If we delay the console rollout by 1 week, what downstream tasks slide? (docs, CS onboarding)
- Are there any risks in forcing legacy kernel selector for short sequences? Perf regression anywhere else?

Quick checklist before 1:1:
- Share this doc with Ethan + Lena (done)
- Pull latest canary logs and SLO graphs (dashboard link in Slack)
- Confirm SRE owner for INF-2345

Bottom line to communicate in exec: we have targeted mitigations for the Console and Dedicated issues; with a 48–72h canary validation window we can keep rollout timeline intact unless canary shows regressions. Private pilot depends on audit log signoff — highlight legal dependency.
summary: Prep notes for 1:1 covering console canary, kernel regression, dedicated provisioning, private pilot compliance. Action items listed with owners/due dates.
